items.summary: CDNA matrix cores DONE: TENSOR=ON ported to rocWMMA (native fp32 MFMA), gfx90a-validated (matches non-tensor docking; 1.57x faster at NUMWI=128), commit 3d466a4. REMAINING (follow-up): RDNA (gfx1100/1101/1201) has no native f32 WMMA input, so TENSOR=ON there needs a bf16 error-correction path (the AMD analog of the NVIDIA tf32+EC tcec). Currently CDNA-only; the Makefile should guard TENSOR=ON to CDNA archs.
